name: chip-design
description: Hierarchical chip design and continuous verification loop. The agent proposes requirements, blocks and artifacts; the loop decides whether a level is verified and whether descent is allowed.

exit_codes.0: complete: every leaf reached the target with passing checks
exit_codes.2: invalid: the design is structurally invalid
exit_codes.3: decompose: checks passed but leaves remain below the target
exit_codes.4: blocked: a check could not run; provide an adapter or tool
